title: Confirm your email
subject: Confirm your Pheelm email
message: Welcome to Pheelm. Confirm your email address to finish creating your account.
preheader: One quick step to finish creating your Pheelm account.
rows: Use the button or the code
Select the button, or type the six-digit code on the sign-in page. Either one works.
It expires soon
The link and code work once and stop working after a short time. If they expire, ask for a new one from the sign-in page.
Keep the code private
Pheelm will never ask you for it by email, message or phone.
note: Didn’t create an account? You can ignore this email. Nothing happens unless the address is confirmed.
authMessage: Welcome to Pheelm. Confirm your email address to finish creating your account. Select the button, or enter the code below on the sign-in page.

title: Sign in to Pheelm
subject: Your Pheelm sign-in link
message: Use the button, or enter the six-digit code, to sign in to Pheelm.
preheader: Your one-time sign-in link and code.
rows: Open it where you want to sign in
Select the button on the device you’re signing in on, or type the code on the sign-in page.
One use only
Once you’re signed in, this link and code stop working. They also expire after a short time.
Keep it private
Don’t forward this email or share the code. Pheelm will never ask for it.
note: Didn’t ask to sign in? Ignore this email and your account stays exactly as it is. If these keep arriving, write to hey@pheelm.com.
authMessage: Use the button, or enter the code below on the sign-in page, to sign in to Pheelm. Never share this code.

title: Reset your password
subject: Reset your Pheelm password
message: We received a request to reset the password for your Pheelm account.
preheader: Choose a new password for your Pheelm account.
rows: Choose something new
Pick a password you don’t use anywhere else, at least 8 characters long.
It expires soon
The link and code work once and stop working after a short time. You can ask for another from the sign-in page.
Your account is safe
Until you use this link, your current password keeps working.
note: Didn’t ask for a reset? Ignore this email and your password stays the same.
authMessage: We received a request to reset the password for your Pheelm account. Select the button, or enter the code below on the sign-in page, to choose a new one.

title: Confirm your new email
subject: Confirm your Pheelm email change
message: Confirm this change to the email address you use to sign in to Pheelm.
preheader: Confirm the new email address for your Pheelm account.
rows: What changes
Once confirmed, you’ll sign in with this address and Pheelm will email you here.
Everything else stays
Your watchlists, followed directors, comments and settings are not affected.
We’ll tell both addresses
For your security, the old and the new address each get a notice when the change is complete.
note: Didn’t ask for this? Don’t select the button, and write to hey@pheelm.com so we can help you secure your account.
authMessage: Confirm this change to the email address you use to sign in to Pheelm.

title: Your sign-in email changed
subject: Your Pheelm account email changed
message: The sign-in email on your Pheelm account changed. If this wasn’t you, contact Pheelm straight away.
preheader: The email address on your Pheelm account was changed.
rows: What changed
The email address used to sign in to your account was updated. The old and the new address both receive this notice.
If it was you
Nothing more to do. Use the new address to sign in from now on.
If it wasn’t you
Write to hey@pheelm.com right away with “Account security” in the subject, and we’ll help you recover your account.
note: Pheelm never asks for your password or sign-in code. We only email you about changes like this one.

title: Welcome to Pheelm
subject: Welcome to Pheelm
message: Discover films, make watchlists and follow directors. Your Pheelm account is ready.
preheader: Your account is ready. Here’s where to start.
rows: Build watchlists
Save films into watchlists, keep them private or share them, and invite others to curate with you.
Follow directors
Follow the directors you love and hear when a new film from them is added.
Make it yours
Add a photo and a short bio, and choose which emails you get, in your account settings.
note: Questions? Visit the Help page or write to hey@pheelm.com.

title: Your account has been deleted
subject: Your Pheelm account has been deleted
message: Your Pheelm account has been deleted. If you didn’t request this, contact Pheelm.
preheader: Your Pheelm account is gone. Here’s what that means.
rows: What was removed
Your profile, watchlists, follows, comments, notifications and profile photo were deleted along with your account.
Emails stop
You won’t receive further account emails. This is the last one unless you contact us.
Want to come back?
You’re welcome to create a new account any time. Deleted content can’t be restored.
note: Didn’t delete your account? Write to hey@pheelm.com straight away so we can look into it.

title: We’ve received your film
subject: Your film submission is with Pheelm
message: Thank you for helping build the catalog. Your submission is awaiting review; it hasn’t been published.
preheader: Your film submission is in. It’s waiting for review.
rows: What happens next
We check each film’s details before adding it. You’ll get an email when the status changes.
Not published yet
Your film doesn’t appear on Pheelm until it has been reviewed and approved.
Keep your reference
The reference above identifies this submission if you ever need to write to us.
note: Spotted a mistake in what you sent? Reply to this email and tell us what to fix.

title: An update on your submission
subject: An update on your Pheelm submission
message: There’s an update on your film submission. Sign in to see its status and any notes.
preheader: The review of your film submission has changed.
rows: Where to look
Open your account and go to Submissions to see the current status and any notes from the team.
Approved means reviewed
An approved submission has been accepted; it may take a little while to appear in the catalog.
Not accepted?
You can send a corrected version, or write to hey@pheelm.com and we’ll explain.
note: Thank you for helping improve the catalog.

title: We’ve got your message
subject: Pheelm received your message
message: Thank you for contacting Pheelm. We received your message.
preheader: We’ve got your message. Keep this email for your reference.
rows: What happens next
Someone at Pheelm reads each message and replies when a reply is needed.
How we reply
Replies come from Pheelm to this address, and you can reply to them directly.
Keep your reference
Quote the reference above if you write to us again about this.
note: We can’t promise a specific response time. For quick answers, the Help page covers the most common questions.

title: A reply from Pheelm
subject: A reply to your Pheelm message
message: There’s a reply to your message.
preheader: Pheelm has replied to your message.
rows: Reply to this email
Just answer this email to continue the conversation. It goes straight to the team.
Your reference
Keep the reference at the end of the message in case you need to mention it later.
Need something else?
For a different question, use the contact page so it reaches the right person.
note: This message was sent because you wrote to Pheelm. If that wasn’t you, you can ignore it.

title: You’re invited to curate a watchlist
subject: You’re invited to curate a Pheelm watchlist
message: A Pheelm member invited you to help curate a watchlist. Sign in to accept or decline.
preheader: You’ve been asked to help curate a watchlist.
rows: What it means
Curators can add films to the watchlist alongside its owner.
You decide
Open your notifications to accept or decline. Nothing changes until you answer.
Change your mind
If you accept, you can leave the watchlist later from its page.
note: You’re getting this because collaboration emails are on. You can switch them off in your account settings.

title: Watchlist collaboration update
subject: Your Pheelm watchlist collaboration
message: There’s an update on a watchlist invitation, request or membership.
preheader: Something changed on a watchlist you collaborate on.
rows: What changed
An invitation, request or membership on a watchlist was updated. The details are in your notifications.
Where to see it
Open your notifications, where you can respond to anything that needs an answer.
You’re in control
Owners decide who curates their watchlist, and members can leave whenever they like.
note: You’re getting this because collaboration emails are on. You can switch them off in your account settings.

title: Confirm your subscription
subject: Confirm your Pheelm newsletter subscription
message: You asked to receive the Pheelm newsletter. Confirm below to subscribe.
preheader: One tap to confirm your Pheelm newsletter subscription.
rows: Nothing is sent yet
You’re not subscribed until you confirm. If you don’t, we won’t email you.
What you’ll get
Occasional notes on films, directors and watchlists chosen by Pheelm. Never your data, never spam.
Leave any time
Every newsletter includes a link to unsubscribe in one step.
note: Didn’t sign up? Ignore this email. You won’t be subscribed, and this link expires on its own.

title: Discoveries from Pheelm
subject: Discoveries from Pheelm
message: Films, directors and watchlists selected by Pheelm.
preheader: This week’s films, directors and watchlists from Pheelm.
rows: Films
New and noteworthy films added to the catalog.
Directors
Filmmakers worth knowing, with the films to start with.
Watchlists
Public watchlists from the community worth a look.
note: You’re receiving this because you subscribed to the Pheelm newsletter.

title: New activity on Pheelm
subject: New activity on Pheelm
message: Someone replied to your comment or mentioned you, a watchlist of yours has a new comment, or a director you follow has a new film.
preheader: There’s something new waiting for you on Pheelm.
rows: What happened
A reply, a mention, a comment on your watchlist, or a new film from a director you follow.
Who and what
For your privacy we don’t put names or comments in emails. Sign in to read them.
Never a flood
We send no more than five of these an hour, however busy it gets.
note: You can turn these emails off at any time under Email notifications in your account settings.

title: New on Pheelm
subject: New on Pheelm
message: Here’s what was added to Pheelm this week.
preheader: Your Pheelm digest: what’s new in the catalog.
rows: What’s inside
New films, directors and public watchlists added since your last digest.
Only the public
Private watchlists and drafts never appear in a digest.
Your schedule
Daily Digests arrive at 4 pm Eastern; weekly ones on Fridays at 4 pm. If nothing new was added, we don’t send one.
note: Change how often you get this, or turn it off, under Email notifications in your account settings.

title: Your report to Pheelm
subject: Your report to Pheelm
message: We received your report. Thank you for helping keep Pheelm respectful.
preheader: We’ve received your report.
rows: What happens next
A person on the team reviews each report against the community guidelines.
Privacy
We may not be able to share the details of moderation decisions that involve other members.
Add more details
If you remember anything else that helps, reply to this email.
note: You can read the community guidelines in the Terms any time.

title: An important update from Pheelm
subject: An important update from Pheelm
message: There’s a moderation decision affecting your account or content.
preheader: A moderation decision affects your account or content.
rows: What it covers
The message above explains what was changed and why.
You can ask for a review
If you think we got it wrong, reply to this email and explain. A person will look again.
Community guidelines
The rules we apply are in the Terms, which everyone on Pheelm follows.
note: We send this only when a moderator has taken a specific action. It’s not an automated warning.

title: An important update about your account
subject: An important update about your Pheelm account
message: An important change affects how you use Pheelm.
preheader: A change affects how you use Pheelm.
rows: What’s changing
The message above explains what is changing and when it takes effect.
What you need to do
If anything is needed from you, it’s explained above. Otherwise, nothing.
Questions
Write to hey@pheelm.com and we’ll help.
note: We only send service notices when something truly affects your account.

title: Your data export is ready
subject: Your Pheelm data export is ready
message: The data export you asked for is ready. Download it before the link expires.
preheader: Your Pheelm data export is ready to download.
rows: Sign in to download
The download is private to your account, so you’ll need to be signed in.
It expires
Use the link soon; after it expires you can ask for a new export.
Keep it safe
Your export contains personal information. Store it somewhere you trust.
note: Didn’t ask for an export? Write to hey@pheelm.com straight away.

title: Pheelm needs your review
subject: Pheelm needs your review
message: Review pending film submissions, reports and messages in Pheelm.
preheader: Items are waiting for your review.
rows: Submissions
Films waiting to be approved or sent back.
Reports
Comments and watchlists flagged by members.
Inbox
Messages from members that need a reply.
note: You’re getting this because you’re a Pheelm admin.
